Cash is yours.
Digital cash should be too.

Physical cash does not need an account provider to exist.

When money sits in a bank, exchange or custodial app, you hold a claim on that institution — an IOU in plain language.

With self-custody, you hold the digital asset itself and can send it directly to another person.

That is the idea behind Nuri: the freedom of cash, made digital and global.

Berlin roots.
A new Nuri.

2014–15Bitwala grows out of Berlin’s early Bitcoin scene. 2021Bitwala becomes Nuri. 2022The original Nuri shuts down. 2025The Nuri brand moves to new ownership and operates independently. NowA new Nuri is built around a simple goal: Bitcoin-first self-custody for everyone, stable internet money when useful, and local payment rails when needed.

The patient pioneers.

We grew up building internet money.

From Berlin’s early Bitcoin scene through Lightning and Ethereum, the people behind Nuri have spent more than a decade working on mining, exchanges, wallets, DAOs, smart contracts, protocols and payment infrastructure.

Cim Topal, Emil Wagner and Lennard Evertz are part of that long story. For now, the public founder profile starts with Emin.

Emin Mahrt Founder · Product

Berlin. Bitcoin since the early 2010s. Wallets, protocols and payments. Former product leadership at Börse Stuttgart Digital Exchange.

An AI reviewing the team’s history once called us “the patient pioneers.” The name stuck.

The destination after all those years: secure self-custody for everyone — people and AI — with a wallet focused on global internet payments and local peer-to-peer cash.

Nuri is operated by Nurisoft Development OÜ, Tallinn, Estonia. Nuri is not a bank. Self-custody describes the crypto wallet, not card or bank balances. Regulated financial services are provided by licensed third parties under separate eligibility, verification and terms.

Open free walletAbout Nuri →

Simple outside. Deeper underneath.

Nuri’s public architecture describes passkey-based self-custody with co-signing and independent recovery. Advanced layers can include hardware security keys, physical passkeys, hardware-wallet cosigning and open recovery tooling.

Read the recovery architecture →

Legal and regulatory boundary.

Nuri itself is not presented as a bank. The wallet is self-custodial software. Regulated services are provided by licensed partners.

  • Wirex Limited (UK) — authorised and regulated by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution, FRN 902025.
  • Transact Payments Malta Limited — authorised and regulated by the Malta Financial Services Authority as an EMI for EEA card services.
  • Monerium hf. — authorised Electronic Money Institution supervised by the Financial Supervisory Authority of the Central Bank of Iceland.
  • ClickPesa Tanzania — licensed by the Bank of Tanzania under Payment System Licensing and Approval Regulations, licence NBPSL No. 0000-31.
